newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ibiden up on brighter earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Ibiden up on brighter earnings forecast.

text.p: Shares of Japanese electrical machinery maker Ibiden Co Ltd gained in heavy volume in Wednesday morning trade, supported by the firm's upward revision of its earnings forecast for the current business year that will end in March, traders said.
The share price rose 20 yen to 1,100 at 0122 GMT. Volume was 1.89 million shares.
The manufacturer of printed circuit boards said on Tuesday that it had revised up its group current profit for 1996/97 to 5.2 billion yen, up from the firm's previous forecast of 3.8 billion yen.
Ibiden also said it expected a 4.6 billion yen parent current profit for the same business year, up from its previous forecast of 3.2 billion yen.
